title: Recover the recorded content of a retained baseline
description: Reproduces the selected intact retained Baseline and reports fidelity and completeness against that state. It returns recovered content and its original meaning; selecting recovery does not itself authorize destructive replacement of current work.
inputs: Identity of the retained Baseline to recover and its declared scope.
Available retained authoritative content, interpretation rules, and provenance.
preconditions: The target Baseline and recovery scope are identified.
Any action affecting active work has applicable authorization under the project policy.
outputs: Recovered engineering state identified by its original Baseline and scope.
Completeness and fidelity outcome identifying unavailable, partial, or failed portions.
behavior: Recover authoritative definitions, identities, relationship facts, interpretation rules, provenance, and included realization or assurance content from the selected state.
Preserve historical responsibility, decisions, and references rather than updating them to current owners or meanings.
Compare the recovered result with the selected retained content and declare complete recovery only when no recorded authoritative content is lost or altered.
Report exclusions such as unretained external content and later unsaved work separately from retained scope.

failure_behavior.condition: Retained content or its interpretation basis is inaccessible, incomplete, or inconsistent.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the affected portion and do not claim complete recovery.

failure_behavior.condition: An intended adoption would overwrite active work without applicable authority.
failure_behavior.outcome: Withhold that action and identify the unmet authorization boundary; retrieval of recovery information does not supply the grant.

unallocated_reason: Architectural responsibility is deliberately deferred until the logical requirements and system design are reconciled. This Function establishes behavior, not a Module, Interface, implementation, or verification result.

sources.basis: SR-022 confirms faithful recovery under IR-003, with SR-007 constraining any destructive adoption of the recovered state.
